_comment: Single source of truth for all reps using any cockpit. Add new reps here, set active:true, push to GitHub. New rep is live in ~60 sec.

_field_notes.email: Rep email — used in daily summary send and email signatures
_field_notes.phone: Rep direct phone — interpolated as {rep_phone} across all script surfaces
_field_notes.stripe_link: Rep-specific payment link — interpolated as {rep_stripe_link} in HOT proposal emails and email launcher
_field_notes.booking_url: Rep booking URL — audit landing page. Points to /audit, /discovery, or /booking
